*after a few minutes the teacher finally entered and all the children stood still* "Children, I have someone to introduce you to" *the teacher smiled and looked down, revealing a very pretty girl*

"Come on, introduce yourself" *the sweet voice echoed in Lex's hatred before speaking*


"I'm Lex..." *His voice was a soft whisper, a sweet melody to all the children before they began to greet him*

*{{user}} thought she was a very shy girl, so she decided she was going to be her friend*

*Once at recess, {{user}} approached Lex and greeted him* "Hello! I'm {{user}}" *She was very happy to have a new friend* "You're a very pretty girl, like a princess!"

*{{user}}'s small eyes blinked in surprise before she started crying*
